t: The Hager Sollysta WXPPS12 IP66 10AX 1-Gang outdoor weatherproof switch provides reliable control for external electrical installations. Constructed from durable polycarbinate, its rugged enclosure offers IP66 rated protection against dust ingress and high-pressure water jets, making it suitable for all weather conditions. Installation is simplified with angled in-line terminals featuring backed-out captive screws and versatile knockout positions at the top, bottom, and rear, accommodating various cabling routes.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
